# The AI expands the Research Facility only when the treasury holds 2 times the price of the next level.
# Prices from DA_RF_expand_one_level (common/scripted_effects/DA_RF_Expansion_effects.txt).
DA_RF_ai_can_afford = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_estate = estate_da_runesmiths } NOT = { has_estate_privilege = estate_da_runesmiths_RF_2 } } treasury = 100 }	# level II, price 50

	else_if = { limit = { has_estate_privilege = estate_da_runesmiths_RF_8 } treasury = 4800 }	# level IX, price 2400
	else_if = { limit = { has_estate_privilege = estate_da_runesmiths_RF_9 } treasury = 10000 }	# level X, price 5000
	else_if = { limit = { has_estate_privilege = estate_da_runesmiths_RF_10 } treasury = 20000 }	# level XI, price 10000
	else = { always = no }
}
